851196.name: FUN12
851196.summary: Enables several functions, including GTP binding activity; small ribosomal subunit rRNA binding activity; and translation initiation factor activity. Involved in formation of cytoplasmic translation initiation complex; regulation of translational initiation; and ribosome biogenesis. Located in cytoplasmic stress granule; cytosol; and mitochondrion. Part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit and eukaryotic 48S preinitiation complex. Orthologous to human EIF5B (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 5B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851222.name: SWC3
851222.summary: Enables nucleosomal DNA binding activity. Involved in chromatin remodeling and endoplasmic reticulum organization. Located in chromatin. Part of Swr1 complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851237.name: GDH3
851237.summary: Enables L-glutamate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity. Involved in L-glutamate biosynthetic process. Located in nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in familial hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia 6; hyperinsulinism; and hypoglycemia. Orthologous to human GLUD1 (glutamate dehydrogenase 1) and GLUD2 (glutamate dehydrogenase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851250.name: SPC72
851250.summary: Enables microtubule lateral binding activity and microtubule plus-end binding activity. Involved in gamma-tubulin complex localization to cytoplasmic side of mitotic spindle pole body; microtubule cytoskeleton organization; and mitotic spindle orientation checkpoint signaling. Located in mitotic spindle astral microtubule end and outer plaque of mitotic spindle pole body. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851261.name: VPS8
851261.summary: Enables GTPase binding activity and protein-membrane adaptor activity. Involved in several processes, including regulation of vacuole fusion, non-autophagic; vacuolar transport; and vesicle tethering. Located in early endosome membrane and late endosome. Part of CORVET complex. Orthologous to human VPS8 (VPS8 subunit of CORVET complex). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851265.name: SWD1
851265.summary: Contributes to histone H3K4 methyltransferase activity. Involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription; subtelomeric heterochromatin formation; and telomere maintenance. Part of Set1C/COMPASS complex. Orthologous to human RBBP5 (RB binding protein 5, histone lysine methyltransferase complex subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851272.name: ADE1
851272.summary: Enables phosphoribosylaminoimidazolesuccinocarboxamide synthase activity. Involved in 'de novo' IMP biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in schizophrenia. Orthologous to human PAICS (phosphoribosylaminoimidazole carboxylase and phosphoribosylaminoimidazolesuccinocarboxamide synthase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851306.name: CDC13
851306.summary: Enables several functions, including single-stranded telomeric DNA binding activity; telomerase inhibitor activity; and translation elongation factor binding activity. Involved in regulation of DNA metabolic process; ribonucleoprotein complex localization; and telomere maintenance. Located in chromosome, telomeric region. Part of CST complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851325.name: MRPL11
851325.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPL10 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L10). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851333.name: SNF3
851333.summary: Predicted to enable carbohydrate:proton symporter activity. Involved in glucose mediated signaling pathway; hexose transmembrane transport; and negative regulation of meiotic nuclear division. Located in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851335.name: ARF1
851335.summary: Enables GTPase activity. Involved in several processes, including Golgi vesicle transport; protein localization to Golgi membrane; and regulation of Golgi organization. Acts upstream of or within positive regulation of mitochondrial fission; positive regulation of mitochondrial fusion; and regulation of fatty acid metabolic process. Located in cytosol. Is active in Golgi apparatus and organelle membrane contact site. Orthologous to several human genes including ARF3 (ARF GTPase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851336.name: RPL35A
851336.summary: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in maturation of LSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit and preribosome, large subunit precursor. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-Blackfan anemia 19. Orthologous to human RPL35 (ribosomal protein L35). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851337.name: UFD2
851337.summary: Enables ubiquitin-ubiquitin ligase activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to ethanol; protein K48-linked ubiquitination; and protein catabolic process. Located in nucleus. Orthologous to human UBE4B (ubiquitination factor E4B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851342.name: VMA1
851342.description: H(+)-transporting V1 sector ATPase subunit A
851342.otherdesignations: H(+)-transporting V1 sector ATPase subunit A
851342.nomenclaturename: H(+)-transporting V1 sector ATPase subunit A
851342.summary: Enables proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. Involved in proton transmembrane transport and vacuolar acidification. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Part of vacuolar proton-transporting V-type ATPase, V1 domain. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive cutis laxa type IID and developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 93. Orthologous to human ATP6V1A (ATPase H+ transporting V1 subunit A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851384.name: UGA3
851384.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in GABA catabolic process; nitrogen utilization; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851406.name: ATG9
851406.summary: Enables phospholipid scramblase activity. Involved in cytoplasm to vacuole targeting by the Cvt pathway; macroautophagy; and phospholipid translocation. Located in cytoplasmic vesicle membrane; mitochondrion; and phagophore. Is active in phagophore assembly site. Orthologous to human ATG9A (autophagy related 9A) and ATG9B (autophagy related 9B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851417.name: RGT2
851417.summary: Enables D-glucose binding activity. Involved in glucose mediated signaling pathway. Located in cell periphery. Is active in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851419.name: RPL35B
851419.summary: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in maturation of LSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit and preribosome, large subunit precursor. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-Blackfan anemia 19. Orthologous to human RPL35 (ribosomal protein L35). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851426.name: STF1
851426.summary: Enables ATPase binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of ATP-dependent activity. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851427.name: RPP1B
851427.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation. Located in fungal-type vacuole. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPLP1 (ribosomal protein lateral stalk subunit P1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851437.name: YFH1
851437.summary: Enables several functions, including ferrous iron binding activity; ferroxidase activity; and iron chaperone activity. Involved in several processes, including glutathione metabolic process; mitochondrial electron transport, succinate to ubiquinone; and response to iron(II) ion. Located in mitochondrial matrix. Used to study Friedreich ataxia; cancer; and iron metabolism disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Friedreich ataxia; Friedreich ataxia 1; glioblastoma; and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human FXN (frataxin). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851452.name: PHO2
851452.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; regulation of histidine biosynthetic process; and regulation of purine nucleobase metabolic process. Located in cytosol and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851457.name: DUN1
851457.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in DNA damage checkpoint signaling. Acts upstream of or within double-strand break repair via nonhomologous end joining and replication fork processing. Located in nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Li-Fraumeni syndrome 2; breast cancer (multiple); colorectal cancer; osteosarcoma; and prostate cancer. Orthologous to human CHEK2 (checkpoint kinase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851459.name: BUG1
851459.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity. Involved in endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport and protein secretion. Located in cis-Golgi network membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851462.name: PMT1
851462.summary: Enables dolichyl-phosphate-mannose-protein mannosyltransferase activity. Involved in several processes, including ERAD pathway; protein O-linked glycosylation via mannose; and protein exit from endoplasmic reticulum. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Part of dolichyl-phosphate-mannose-protein mannosyltransferase Pmt1p-Pmt2p dimer complex and dolichyl-phosphate-mannose-protein mannosyltransferase Pmt1p-Pmt3p dimer complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851464.name: PMT5
851464.summary: Predicted to enable dolichyl-phosphate-mannose-protein mannosyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein O-linked glycosylation via mannose. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Part of dolichyl-phosphate-mannose-protein mannosyltransferase Pmt5p-Pmt2p dimer complex and dolichyl-phosphate-mannose-protein mannosyltransferase Pmt5p-Pmt3p dimer complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851474.name: NDE2
851474.summary: Predicted to enable NADH dehydrogenase activity. Involved in pyruvate fermentation to ethanol. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851477.name: RPL13A
851477.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL13 (ribosomal protein L13). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851478.name: RPP1A
851478.summary: Enables protein kinase activator activity. A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPLP1 (ribosomal protein lateral stalk subunit P1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851484.name: RPL31A
851484.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation and regulation of translational fidelity. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL31 (ribosomal protein L31). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851491.name: CBS1
851491.summary: Enables translation regulator activity. Involved in mitochondrial respiratory chain complex III assembly and positive regulation of mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane and mitochondrial ribosome. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851493.name: IDP1
851493.summary: Enables isocitrate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity. Involved in L-glutamate biosynthetic process. Located in mitochondrial nucleoid. Used to study high grade glioma. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autoimmune disease; hematologic cancer (multiple); hepatocellular clear cell carcinoma; and high grade glioma (multiple). Orthologous to human IDH1 (isocitrate dehydrogenase (NADP(+)) 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851502.name: YDL057W
851502.summary: Predicted to enable monoacylglycerol lipase activity. Predicted to be active in membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851520.name: SIR2
851520.summary: Enables DNA replication origin binding activity and histone deacetylase activity, NAD-dependent. Contributes to nucleosome binding activity. Involved in several processes, including establishment of protein-containing complex localization to telomere; negative regulation of DNA metabolic process; and negative regulation of gene expression. Located in chromosome, telomeric region; heterochromatin; and nucleolus. Part of RENT complex. Is active in nucleus. Used to study Alzheimer's disease; Parkinson's disease; diabetes mellitus; and prostate cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Huntington's disease. Orthologous to human SIRT1 (sirtuin 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851527.name: GPR1
851527.summary: Enables D-glucose binding activity and G protein-coupled receptor activity. Involved in several processes, including detection of sucrose stimulus; invasive growth in response to glucose limitation; and sugar mediated signaling pathway. Located in plasma membrane. Orthologous to human GPR157 (G protein-coupled receptor 157). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851542.name: RPN4
851542.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to arsenic-containing substance; regulation of DNA repair; and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851543.name: OSH2
851543.summary: Enables lipid binding activity and sterol transfer activity. Involved in several processes, including ER to Golgi ceramide transport; maintenance of cell polarity; and piecemeal microautophagy of the nucleus. Acts upstream of or within reticulophagy. Located in several cellular components, including cellular bud neck; cortical endoplasmic reticulum; and nuclear envelope. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 67. Orthologous to several human genes including OSBP (oxysterol binding protein) and OSBP2 (oxysterol binding protein 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2025]

851557.name: RPT2
851557.description: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT2
851557.otherdesignations: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT2
851557.nomenclaturename: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT2
851557.summary: Enables ATP hydrolysis activity and proteasome-activating activity. Involved in several processes, including nonfunctional rRNA decay; peptide catabolic process; and proteasome regulatory particle assembly. Located in nucleus. Part of proteasome regulatory particle, base subcomplex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neurodevelopmental disorder with poor growth, spastic tetraplegia, and hearing loss. Orthologous to human PSMC1 (proteasome 26S subunit, ATPase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851564.name: NTH1
851564.summary: Enables alpha,alpha-trehalase activity. Involved in cellular response to desiccation and trehalose catabolic process. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human TREH (trehalase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851566.name: RCR2
851566.summary: Enables ubiquitin-like ligase-substrate adaptor activity. Involved in protein localization to vacuole and vesicle-mediated transport. Located in vesicle. Is active in fungal-type vacuole. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851567.name: RAD57
851567.summary: Predicted to enable DNA binding activity and catalytic activity, acting on DNA. Involved in DNA metabolic process and positive regulation of single-strand break repair via homologous recombination. Part of Rad51C-XRCC3 complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including artery disease (multiple); central nervous system cancer (multiple); familial melanoma; multiple myeloma; and pancreatic cancer. Orthologous to human XRCC3 (X-ray repair cross complementing 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851569.name: SOK1
851569.summary: Involved in cAMP/PKA signal transduction. Located in nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including TCP11 (t-complex 11). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851583.name: DAS2
851583.summary: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity; cytidine kinase activity; and uridine kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in CMP biosynthetic process; CTP salvage; and UMP salvage. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human UCK1 (uridine-cytidine kinase 1) and UCK2 (uridine-cytidine kinase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851589.name: RPS11A
851589.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA) and ribosomal small subunit assembly. Part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPS11 (ribosomal protein S11). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851592.name: REG1
851592.summary: Predicted to enable protein phosphatase regulator activity. Involved in cellular response to glucose starvation; protein catabolic process in the vacuole; and response to unfolded protein. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851596.name: PST2
851596.summary: Enables NAD(P)H dehydrogenase (quinone) activity and identical protein binding activity. Acts upstream of or within positive regulation of ferroptosis. Located in eisosome. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851618.name: VMS1
851618.summary: Enables RNA endonuclease activity and peptidyl-tRNA hydrolase activity. Involved in proteasomal protein catabolic process and rescue of stalled cytosolic ribosome. Located in cytosol; endoplasmic reticulum membrane; and mitochondrion. Part of Cdc48p-Npl4p-Vms1p AAA ATPase complex. Used to study inflammatory bowel disease. Orthologous to human ANKZF1 (ankyrin repeat and zinc finger peptidyl tRNA hydrolase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851627.name: YOS9
851627.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and oligosaccharide binding activity. Involved in endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response; retrograde protein transport, ER to cytosol; and ubiquitin-dependent glycoprotein ERAD pathway. Located in endoplasmic reticulum lumen. Part of Hrd1p ubiquitin ligase ERAD-L complex and luminal surveillance complex. Orthologous to several human genes including ERLEC1 (endoplasmic reticulum lectin 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851637.name: RRG1
851637.summary: Involved in mitochondrial tRNA 5'-end processing and vacuolar acidification. Located in matrix side of mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851641.name: DOA4
851641.otheraliases: YDR069C, DOS1, MUT4, NPI2, SSV7, UBP4
851641.summary: Enables cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity. Involved in several processes, including ATP export; free ubiquitin chain depolymerization; and intralumenal vesicle formation. Located in endosome. Part of proteasome complex. Orthologous to human USP2 (ubiquitin specific peptidase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851642.name: FMP16
851642.summary: Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851643.name: PAA1
851643.summary: Enables aralkylamine N-acetyltransferase activity and diamine N-acetyltransferase activity. Involved in chromatin organization. Located in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in advanced sleep phase syndrome. Orthologous to human AANAT (aralkylamine N-acetyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851644.name: IPT1
851644.summary: Enables transferase activity, transferring phosphorus-containing groups. Involved in mannosyl diphosphorylinositol ceramide metabolic process; negative regulation of autophagy; and sphingolipid biosynthetic process. Located in membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851647.name: PPH3
851647.description: phosphoprotein phosphatase PP4 catalytic subunit PPH3
851647.otherdesignations: phosphoprotein phosphatase PP4 catalytic subunit PPH3
851647.nomenclaturename: phosphoprotein phosphatase PP4 catalytic subunit PPH3
851647.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of glucose mediated signaling pathway; positive regulation of double-strand break repair via nonhomologous end joining; and regulation of cell cycle phase transition. Acts upstream of or within regulation of TORC1 signaling. Located in nuclear periphery. Part of protein phosphatase 4 complex. Orthologous to human PPP4C (protein phosphatase 4 catalytic subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851648.name: RAD55
851648.summary: Predicted to enable ATP-dependent activity, acting on DNA. Predicted to contribute to crossover junction DNA endonuclease activity and four-way junction DNA binding activity. Involved in DNA metabolic process and positive regulation of single-strand break repair via homologous recombination. Part of Rad51C-XRCC3 complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851653.name: VPS41
851653.otheraliases: YDR080W, CVT8, FET2, SVL2, VAM2, VPL20
851653.summary: Enables small GTPase binding activity. Contributes to phosphatidylinositol binding activity. Involved in several processes, including double-strand break repair via break-induced replication; piecemeal microautophagy of the nucleus; and vacuolar protein processing. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Part of HOPS complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 29. Orthologous to human VPS41 (VPS41 subunit of HOPS complex). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851656.name: RRP8
851656.summary: Enables rRNA (adenine) methyltransferase activity. Involved in rRNA methylation and ribosomal large subunit biogenesis. Located in nucleolus. Part of 90S preribosome. Orthologous to human RRP8 (ribosomal RNA processing 8). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851657.name: TVP23
851657.summary: Involved in vesicle-mediated transport. Located in Golgi membrane. Orthologous to several human genes including TVP23A (trans-golgi network vesicle protein 23 homolog A) and TVP23B (trans-golgi network vesicle protein 23 homolog B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851663.name: VTC5
851663.summary: Involved in intracellular phosphate ion homeostasis and polyphosphate biosynthetic process. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Part of vacuolar transporter chaperone complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851670.name: GIS1
851670.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity; and histone H3K36 demethylase activity. Involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and regulation of phospholipid biosynthetic process. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including autistic disorder; autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 65; gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); head and neck cancer; and withdrawal disorder. Orthologous to several human genes including KDM4A (lysine demethylase 4A); KDM4B (lysine demethylase 4B); and KDM4C (lysine demethylase 4C). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851671.name: MSH6
851671.summary: Enables ATP binding activity; ATP hydrolysis activity; and four-way junction DNA binding activity. Contributes to guanine/thymine mispair binding activity and single base insertion or deletion binding activity. Involved in interstrand cross-link repair; meiotic mismatch repair; and replication fork arrest. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Part of MutSalpha complex. Used to study breast cancer; cancer (multiple); mismatch repair cancer syndrome; and ovarian disease (multiple). Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Lynch syndrome; colorectal carcinoma; endometrial cancer; hereditary nonpolyposis colorectal cancer type 5; and mismatch repair cancer syndrome. Orthologous to human MSH6 (mutS homolog 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851676.name: BMH2
851676.summary: Enables DNA replication origin binding activity and phosphoserine residue binding activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA-templated DNA replication; chitin biosynthetic process; and intracellular signal transduction. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human YWHAE (tyrosine 3-monooxygenase/tryptophan 5-monooxygenase activation protein epsilon). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851677.name: TVP15
851677.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity. Involved in vesicle-mediated transport. Located in Golgi membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851686.name: TRS85
851686.summary: Involved in several processes, including Cvt vesicle assembly; endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport; and macroautophagy. Located in Golgi apparatus; cytoplasmic vesicle; and phagophore assembly site. Part of TRAPPIII protein complex. Orthologous to human TRAPPC8 (trafficking protein particle complex subunit 8). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851688.name: FOB1
851688.description: replication fork barrier binding protein FOB1
851688.otherdesignations: replication fork barrier binding protein FOB1
851688.nomenclaturename: replication fork barrier binding protein FOB1
851688.summary: Enables rDNA spacer replication fork barrier binding activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA recombination; nucleolus organization; and regulation of DNA metabolic process. Located in nucleolus and rDNA heterochromatin. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851690.name: ALT2
851690.summary: Enables pyridoxal phosphate binding activity. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neurodevelopmental disorder with spastic paraplegia and microcephaly. Orthologous to human GPT (glutamic--pyruvic transaminase) and GPT2 (glutamic--pyruvic transaminase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851692.name: MRX14
851692.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion and nucleus. Orthologous to human MRPL34 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L34). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851699.name: DPB4
851699.summary: Enables nucleosomal DNA binding activity. Contributes to DNA binding activity; DNA polymerase processivity factor activity; and single-stranded DNA 3'-5' DNA exonuclease activity. Involved in DNA replication; chromatin remodeling; and regulation of DNA double-strand break processing. Located in nuclear replication fork. Part of CHRAC and epsilon DNA polymerase complex. Orthologous to human POLE3 (DNA polymerase epsilon 3, accessory subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851702.name: YDR124W
851702.summary: Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851704.name: SWF1
851704.summary: Enables palmitoyltransferase activity. Involved in several processes, including cortical actin cytoskeleton organization; protein palmitoylation; and vacuole fusion, non-autophagic. Located in actin cortical patch; actin filament bundle; and nuclear outer membrane-endoplasmic reticulum membrane network. Orthologous to human ZDHHC4 (zDHHC palmitoyltransferase 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851706.name: MTC5
851706.summary: Predicted to enable signaling adaptor activity. Involved in positive regulation of TORC1 signaling. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Part of Seh1-associated complex. Orthologous to human WDR59 (WD repeat domain 59). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851707.name: SAC6
851707.summary: Enables actin filament binding activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in formin-nucleated actin cable assembly. Located in actin cortical patch and actin filament bundle. Used to study Huntington's disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 76; congenital diaphragmatic hernia; and nicotine dependence. Orthologous to several human genes including PLS1 (plastin 1) and PLS3 (plastin 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851708.name: FIN1
851708.summary: Enables microtubule binding activity. A structural constituent of cytoskeleton. Involved in several processes, including cytoskeleton organization; deactivation of mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint; and protein localization to kinetochore. Located in cytoskeleton; kinetochore; and nucleus. Part of protein phosphatase type 1 complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851710.name: MRX16
851710.summary: Predicted to be involved in protein homooligomerization. Located in mitochondrion and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851724.name: SWI5
851724.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity; and mediator complex binding activity. Involved in mitotic cell cycle phase transition; positive regulation of mating type switching; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851729.name: CTH1
851729.summary: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Involved in intracellular iron ion homeostasis; negative regulation of mitochondrial translation; and nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including ZFP36 (ZFP36 zinc finger CCCH-type). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851755.name: RSM24
851755.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPS35 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein S35). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851762.name: SAS4
851762.summary: Enables histone acetyltransferase activity. Involved in subtelomeric heterochromatin formation. Located in chromatin. Part of SAS acetyltransferase complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851775.name: MSS116
851775.summary: Enables G-quadruplex DNA binding activity; G-quadruplex RNA binding activity; and nucleic acid conformation isomerase activity. Involved in RNA folding and gene expression. Located in mitochondrial ribosome. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851788.name: UME6
851788.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity; DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of inositol biosynthetic process; positive regulation of phospholipid biosynthetic process; and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Part of Rpd3L complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851802.name: ADR1
851802.summary: Enables several functions, including DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; RNA polymerase II general transcription initiation factor binding activity; and transcription coactivator activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to ethanol; positive regulation of fatty acid beta-oxidation; and positive regulation of peroxisome organization. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851803.name: RAD9
851803.summary: Enables double-stranded DNA binding activity; enzyme activator activity; and histone binding activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA repair; mitotic DNA damage checkpoint signaling; and negative regulation of DNA strand resection involved in replication fork processing. Located in chromatin. Is active in site of DNA damage. Orthologous to human TP53BP1 (tumor protein p53 binding protein 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851812.name: ADK1
851812.summary: Enables AMP kinase activity; DNA replication origin binding activity; and adenyl ribonucleotide binding activity. Involved in ADP biosynthetic process; DNA replication initiation; and pre-replicative complex assembly. Located in cytosol and mitochondrial intermembrane space. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in reticular dysgenesis. Orthologous to human AK2 (adenylate kinase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851813.name: SIR4
851813.summary: Enables double-stranded DNA binding activity; molecular adaptor activity; and nucleosome binding activity. Involved in several processes, including constitutive heterochromatin formation; establishment of protein-containing complex localization to telomere; and positive regulation of heterochromatin formation. Located in chromosome, telomeric region. Part of chromatin silencing complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851819.name: RTN1
851819.summary: Involved in several processes, including ER-dependent peroxisome organization; endoplasmic reticulum organization; and nuclear pore complex assembly. Located in Golgi apparatus; cortical endoplasmic reticulum; and cytoplasmic side of endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Orthologous to human RTN4 (reticulon 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851831.name: PEX5
851831.summary: Enables peroxisome matrix targeting signal-1 binding activity; protein carrier activity; and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in protein import into peroxisome matrix, docking. Located in peroxisomal membrane. Part of peroxisomal importomer complex. Is active in cytosol and peroxisomal matrix. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in peroxisome biogenesis disorder 2A; peroxisome biogenesis disorder 2B; and rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata type 5. Orthologous to human PEX5 (peroxisomal biogenesis factor 5) and PEX5L (peroxisomal biogenesis factor 5 like). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851834.name: VHS1
851834.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle and regulation of protein localization. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851835.name: YDR248C
851835.summary: Enables gluconokinase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Located in fungal-type vacuole. Orthologous to human IDNK (IDNK gluconokinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851843.name: CTA1
851843.summary: Enables catalase activity. Involved in hydrogen peroxide catabolic process and response to reactive oxygen species. Located in mitochondrial matrix and peroxisomal matrix. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including acatalasia; eye disease (multiple); lung disease (multiple); osteonecrosis; and pseudoxanthoma elasticum. Orthologous to human CAT (catalase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851855.name: YDR262W
851855.summary: Located in fungal-type vacuole. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851857.name: AKR1
851857.summary: Enables G-protein beta/gamma-subunit complex binding activity and palmitoyltransferase activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of pheromone-dependent signal transduction involved in conjugation with cellular fusion; protein palmitoylation; and protein targeting to membrane. Located in Golgi apparatus. Orthologous to human ZDHHC13 (zDHHC palmitoyltransferase 13) and ZDHHC17 (zDHHC palmitoyltransferase 17). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851861.name: MSW1
851861.summary: Enables tryptophan-tRNA ligase activity. Involved in mitochondrial tryptophanyl-tRNA aminoacylation. Located in mitochondrion. Used to study mitochondrial metabolism disease and movement disease. Orthologous to human WARS2 (tryptophanyl tRNA synthetase 2, mitochondrial). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851868.name: TLD1
851868.summary: Acts upstream of or within lipid catabolic process. Is active in lipid droplet. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851869.name: PMP3
851869.summary: Enables phospholipid binding activity and sphingolipid binding activity. Involved in monoatomic cation transport and regulation of membrane potential. Located in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851877.name: GCN2
851877.summary: Enables several functions, including RNA binding activity; eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2alpha kinase activity; and protein homodimerization activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to histidine; intracellular signal transduction; and regulation of translational initiation in response to stress. Located in cytosolic ribosome. Part of large ribosomal subunit and small ribosomal subunit. Used to study colorectal cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pulmonary venoocclusive disease 2. Orthologous to human EIF2AK4 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2 alpha kinase 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851879.name: ZIP1
851879.summary: Enables SUMO polymer binding activity. Involved in several processes, including meiosis I; negative regulation of reciprocal meiotic recombination; and positive regulation of protein sumoylation. Acts upstream of or within positive regulation of strand invasion. Located in chromosome, centromeric region and transverse filament. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851881.name: INM2
851881.summary: Enables inositol monophosphate 1-phosphatase activity. Involved in inositol phosphate catabolic process. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder 59; bipolar disorder; intellectual disability; and schizophrenia. Orthologous to several human genes including IMPA2 (inositol monophosphatase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2025]

851887.name: SSD1
851887.summary: Enables mRNA 3'-UTR binding activity; mRNA 5'-UTR binding activity; and mRNA regulatory element binding translation repressor activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of translation; regulation of G1 to G0 transition; and regulation of fungal-type cell wall organization. Located in cellular bud neck; cytoplasmic ribonucleoprotein granule; and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Perlman syndrome and nephroblastoma. Orthologous to human DIS3L2 (DIS3 like 3'-5' exoribonuclease 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851889.name: HDA2
851889.summary: Enables DNA binding activity and chromatin binding activity. Contributes to histone deacetylase activity. Involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulatory ncRNA-mediated gene silencing. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Part of HDA1 complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]
